k:HH.Bank.Building.DirectDepositDesc: On: the tills of your businesses are emptied into your bank account at midnight. Off: the takings are put down as silver next to the safe.
k:HH.Bank.Building.NoAccount: No account yet. Open one here or at a comms console.
k:HH.Bank.Building.SafeDirect: Takings go straight to the account at midnight.
k:HH.Bank.Building.SafeFloor: Takings are put down as silver at midnight.
k:HH.Bank.Building.SafeNoAccount: No bank account: takings are put down as silver at midnight.
k:HH.Bank.Choose.Intro: Moving the account costs {0} silver, taken from the account. Loans stay with the bank that made them.
k:HH.Bank.Choose.Title: Change banks
k:HH.Bank.Comm.Info: Banking, loans and the occasional dry remark.
k:HH.Bank.Header.TierTip: Net worth = account + silver at home − debts: {0} silver. The tier only changes after a new value has held for a whole day. It sets the colony mood from this bank (setting: bank.moodOn).
k:HH.Bank.Hist.TotalFeesTip: All fees, late fees and the price of changing banks.
k:HH.Bank.Hist.TotalInterestTip: Everything the bank has paid you in interest (negative interest counted against it).
k:HH.Bank.Letter.Bailout: {0} has decided that you are, in fact, too big to fail, and has rescued you with an interest-free loan of {1} silver. It runs for 60 days. This is a loan, not a gift. Nobody ever reads that part.
k:HH.Bank.Letter.Late:
Dear customer,

loan {0} is now several days behind. A late fee has been added and your credit score has taken a small, unavoidable dent. The amount due is {1} silver.

The tone of these letters will change.

Clerk Ottoline
k:HH.Bank.Letter.Offset: Until loan {0} is settled, half of every deposit that reaches your account is applied to the debt, and no new loans are available. This is the part of the contract nobody remembers signing.
k:HH.Bank.Letter.Reminder:
Dear customer,

we noticed that an instalment of {0} silver on loan {1} has not yet reached us. We are sure this is an oversight, and we remain, as ever, entirely at your service.

Warm regards,
Clerk Ottoline, {2}
k:HH.Bank.Letter.Seized: A clerk from {0} regrets to inform you that {1} silver of your balance has been "reallocated for administrative reasons". There is no appeal form. There is, however, a very nice pen.
k:HH.Bank.Letter.Visit: Two representatives of Rim Recovery Partners have arrived. They are wearing bowler hats. They have no weapons and no appointment. They will stand near your door, quite calmly, until loan {0} is paid. They never attack, and they leave the moment the money does.
k:HH.Bank.Loans.LimitTip: 0.15 × wealth × (score − 300) / 550, where wealth = net worth + a quarter of the colony wealth. At least the starter credit ({0} silver) for a fine score.
k:HH.Bank.Loans.None: No loans. Ottoline is almost disappointed.
k:HH.Bank.Loans.Quote: {0} silver at {1} % a year: {2} every {3} days, {4} in total ({5} interest).
k:HH.Bank.Loans.RateTip: Base rate max(2 %, M − 1) = {0} % plus the spread of your bank ({1} points). It follows the profitability slider, so borrowing to invest never has a positive expectation.
k:HH.Bank.Loans.ScoreTip: 300 to 850, starts at 600. On-time instalment +4, every late day -6, default -120, using more than 70 % of the limit -20, plus 20 × log10(wealth / 10,000). Base score {0}.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.BalanceTip:
Exact: {0} silver.
Interest every day: balance × (M^({1} × {2} / 60) − 1), with M = {3} per game year (the profitability slider). That is {4:0.##} % a day.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.CashTip: Silver lying around on your home maps.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.DebtTip: Sum of your open loans including accrued interest.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.DirectTip: Tills of your businesses are emptied into the account at midnight, minus {0} %.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.InterestTip: Interest paid on the balance since the quadrum began (15 days).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.NetTip: Account + silver at home − debts. Sets your wealth tier.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.Nothing: Nothing yet. A deposit would be a fine start.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.TradeTip: Silver you get from traders and trade ships goes into the account right after the deal, at the same fee as direct deposit, instead of lying on the floor as coins. Needs direct deposit. Off by default, so you can still pay the next trader in cash. Caravans are not affected.
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.TransitTip: Silver that has left your storage but is not credited yet (deposit delay without a branch or ATM).
k:HH.Bank.Lobby.WdInstant: cash at the building at once
k:HH.Bank.Msg.DepositArrived: {0} silver was credited to your account.
k:HH.Bank.Msg.Missed: The instalment of loan {0} could not be paid.
k:HH.Bank.Msg.PodsComing: {0} silver is on its way down in drop pods.
k:HH.Bank.Msg.Settled: Loan {0} is back in good standing.
k:HH.Bank.Msg.TradeDeposit: Trade income of {0} silver went straight into your account at {1}.
k:HH.Bank.Open.Direct: Route till money straight to the bank at midnight
k:HH.Bank.Open.DirectTip: Takings of your shops, inn and casino go into the account instead of lying around as silver. You can switch this later at a night safe or in the settings (bank.directDeposit).
k:HH.Bank.Open.Intro: Pick a bank. Opening an account is free; moving it later costs {0} silver. Until you have an account, nothing here bothers you, no letters, no mood, no fees.
k:HH.Bank.Open.Title: Silverline: open an account
k:HH.Bank.Quip.B: Please take a number. We have not had a number since the Third Collapse, but the gesture matters.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.C: Every coin here is accounted for. Mostly by me. At night.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Collectors: My colleagues in the hats are not here for you. Do not look at them. They know.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.D: Mattresses are not a financial product. Though I hear they have a following.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Debt: Debt is just savings from the future. The future is unusually keen to have them back.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.E: If anyone asks, the pen is not for sale.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Empty: An empty account is just a very honest account.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Huge: At this size we are no longer your bank. We are your climate.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Interest: Interest this quadrum: {0}. That is, if I count correctly, some meals. Congratulations?
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Overdue: We do not wish to alarm you. We have simply noticed that you have not noticed.
k:HH.Bank.Quip.Rich: Four digits. Your hat is practically a top hat.
k:HH.Bank.Raid.Bounty: {0} has sold the debt of loan {1} to people who do not send letters. There is a price on the head of your colony's leader.
k:HH.Bank.Raid.Text: Rim Recovery Partners has run out of patience with loan {0}. Their agents are coming for valuables worth more than the debt. They will take what they can carry and go.
k:HH.Bank.Raid.Title: Collection raid
k:HH.Bank.Reason.Arrears: You are behind on a payment. Nobody lends to you until that is settled.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.AtmLimit: The ATM will only hand out {0} more today.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.BankUnavailable: That bank is not open to you.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.Funds: The account does not cover {0} plus {1} in fees.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.LoansResearch: Loans need the research project "consumer credit".
k:HH.Bank.Reason.NoCredit: Your credit limit is used up ({0} silver left).
k:HH.Bank.Reason.NoSilver: Not enough silver in storage or at the trade beacon ({0} available).
k:HH.Bank.Reason.OverLimit: That is more than the {0} silver you may still borrow.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.SwitchFunds: Moving the account costs {0} silver and the account does not hold that.
k:HH.Bank.Reason.Title: {0} only lends to holders of a royal title.
k:HH.Bank.Seizure.Done: The team loaded up {0} silver worth of your belongings ({1}) and left, whistling. The debt is {2}.
k:HH.Bank.Seizure.Refused: The recovery team politely stops being polite.
k:HH.Bank.Seizure.Text: A seizure team from Rim Recovery Partners is at the door with a court order that appears to be a laminated napkin. They want valuables worth about {0} silver (120 % of loan {1}). Let them take it, and the loan is gone. Refuse, and they will take it the hard way.
k:HH.Bank.Seizure.Title: Seizure notice
